summary: Verified Phase-1 batch of 4 bug fixes on Wayly. BUG1 (invoice SHA-256 dedup) backend confirmed via pytest (first 200 -> second 409 DUPLICATE_EXACT with existing_invoice_id/provider_name/invoice_date/created_at/message); web + mobile UI dupe-notice testIDs (inv1-duplicate, inv1-duplicate-open, inv1-duplicate-reset) verified in source. BUG2 (no em-dash in greeting) visually confirmed on Cathy's dashboard ('Good afternoon, Cathy. What would you like to do?'). BUG3 (trial banner copy) source-verified: TrialCountdownBanner.jsx uses 'Your plan starts automatically when the trial ends.' / 'Your trial ends tomorrow. Your plan starts automatically, no action needed.'; global grep confirms 'Add a payment method' string is gone from /app/frontend/src. Could NOT render the banner live because the trialactive@example.com account currently reports subscription_status=None / trial_ends_at=None in this preview env, so the banner does not mount. BUG4 (Account Health consolidation) visually confirmed: 'Finish setting up your account' card is present with Show toggle; no standalone accuracy-guarantee or verify-email banner shown at top of the dashboard. Statement dedup regression path skipped because Cathy's account triggers logical-duplicate on the salted ATHM fixture, so no fresh active row exists to exercise the exact-SHA lookup (not a bug).
action_items: Optional: seed trialactive@example.com with subscription_status='trialing' + trial_ends_at=<future> in the preview env so future testing agents can render the TrialCountdownBanner UI end-to-end (currently the account is not in a trialing state so BUG3 could only be source-verified).
critical_code_review_comments: invoices.py duplicate check correctly excludes soft-deleted rows (state != deleted) so users can re-upload after delete, mirroring statement behaviour.
TrialCountdownBanner.jsx CTA still labels 'Manage Billing' -> /settings/billing which is fine; if product wants a lighter CTA later, this is the surface.

success_rate.backend: 100% (2/2 relevant invoice-dup tests pass; 2 statement regression tests skipped due to pre-existing semantic-dup in Cathy's account)
success_rate.frontend: 3/4 verified live (BUG2/BUG4 web via screenshot, BUG1 web+mobile via source review + backend pytest); BUG3 source-verified only (trialactive account not in trial state in preview env)

seed_data_creation: None. Invoice fixture is Meridian test PDF salted with random bytes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice duplicate detection is fully wired: POST /api/invoices/upload -> 409 with detail.error='DUPLICATE_EXACT' and existing_invoice_id/provider_name/invoice_date/created_at/message. Web UI: /ai-tools/invoice-checker renders data-testid='inv1-duplicate' + 'inv1-duplicate-open' (Link -> /app/invoices/{id}) + 'inv1-duplicate-reset'. Mobile: /tool/invoice-checker renders testID equivalents. Dashboard greeting has no em-dash; Account Health card consolidates onboarding items. TrialCountdownBanner copy uses 'starts automatically...' — no 'Add a payment method' anywhere in /app/frontend/src. To re-test BUG3 live, refresh trialactive@example.com to subscription_status='trialing' + trial_ends_at future date.
